diagnostic.presentation: Generated canonical/reverse output bytes are identical. Retained Markdown is subsequently formatted with the repository Prettier; table cells and parsed provenance/context JSON are verified unchanged.
diagnostic.semantic_comparison: Ten loaded arrays compare directly with numpy.testing.assert_array_equal(strict=True); report equality additionally checks model/policy/build identity, item axes, vocabulary fingerprint and all ordered component rows. Canonical/reversed catalog, profile, profile-item and feedback input orders are exercised.
diagnostic.input_provenance: Authored in the test-only generator; no events, real users, database extraction or raw identity fields. Only transient fixture profiles; retained output contains aggregate/game-level context and array hashes.
diagnostic.manual_review: M03 VERIFIED: explicit variant universes, native source/dislike semantics, unsupported behavior, tie keys and top-K. Full-catalog popularity ignores feedback; native content ignores feedback and keeps zero-content rows ineligible. Feedback/collaborative/hybrid exclusions are applied by current policy functions. The diagnostic-only popularity slug tie and pure collaborative top-K presentation are not new product policies.
diagnostic.arithmetic: Identical/orthogonal documents give exact supported content cosines; cold unigram and 65/35 mixture values follow the documented TF-IDF formula. Item supports a/d=8, b/z=10, c=2; pair a-b=8 yields 894427. Played b has hybrid contributions 760000+100000+89443=949443, then factor 500000 gives 474722, delta -474721. Missing a-c retains 100000 collaborative weight with absent support and zero contribution. Collaborative-only d has zero content but base 165000 and hybrid final 232000. Cold e remains eligible by content with absent collaborative support and no weight reallocation.

findings.fallback: R20 covers 11 unavailable plus 4 no-support reasons. Fallback envelope mode/reason, exact Stage 4 object identity, dataclass equality including scores/order/evidence/reasons; richer fixtures contain played, disliked and wishlisted state.
findings.invalid_input: 16 new invalid-context/feedback combinations propagate the same Stage 4 exception type/message through unavailable or ready/no-support outcomes. Existing ready-context, exclusion, unknown-candidate and invalid-outcome tests remain in the focused gate.
findings.weights_and_exclusions: R17–R19 reused for exact candidate union, materialization, positive/source/dislike exclusions, evidence, request-wide weights, cautious prose and fixed-point reconstruction. New hand-derived five-variant goldens, cold/mixed/empty/tied scenarios and prefix top-K checks close the diagnostic gap.
findings.wishlist: Eight full-result/prepared-context equality combinations: saved or positive source, played candidate, collaborative candidate and content candidate; affinity active/inactive produces 80/10/10 or 90/0/10 weights. Full ML also reruns inherited Stage 4 neutrality.

fixes: Corrected the diagnostic fixture ID to the required stage-5- prefix.
Replaced invalid all-inactive feedback rows with absence, adding a wishlist-only row only when selected.
Expanded initial undersized fixture to ten synthetic profiles/five supported items under unchanged artifact activation minima; recalculated hand-derived support/cosine goldens.
Copied the immutable vocabulary mapping into a plain dictionary for diagnostic fingerprint JSON serialization.
Updated existing fallback fixtures to carry active played/disliked/wishlist state, and added a cold-content item scenario during review.
Refreshed inventory node line references, retained per-layer fallback status and normalized document formatting.
review.privacy: Reviewed changed tests/helper, generated table, runtime logs and staged diff. Retained only synthetic aggregate/game-level evidence, commands, runtime versions and hashes; raw logs and temporary bundles remain ignored or container-temporary. No credentials, internal user IDs, real interaction snapshots, artifact members or coverage output staged.
limitations: Linux Docker/WSL2 execution on Windows only.
No PostgreSQL/live/web build required by 9D; these were not run.
No API/event/browser/producer acceptance claim; later-owner routes remain pending.
Production contribution authority remains blocked, and Stage 6 quality evaluation remains deferred.
review.teardown: All quality runs used --rm --no-deps; final docker ps -a -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=quality returned empty output. No database project created, no development service removed.
review.inventory: PASS: unchanged 47 Stage 5 acceptance bullets, 22 suite bullets, 171 inherited bullets; all 15 fallback rows retain explicit ML versus later-layer statuses. 158 Python node references and 635 Markdown links resolve. Eight diagnostic scenario tables and JSON contexts match generated data after formatting.
